purpose: Content-addressed reproducibility bundle for the Node/Bun differential-oracle throughput report, with recorded resolved runtime versions and paths, a freshness window, and a fail-closed degraded receipt when the denominator is unavailable.

required_files.role: distilled measured denominator + per-case correctness verdicts (the results.json analogue)
host / toolchain facts plus recorded resolved Node/Bun versions and paths; nominal manifest pins are not enforced
locked replay recipe; expected output is the byte-identical correctness-verdict hash
content-addressed index referencing env.json, repro.lock, and denominator.json by sha256

optional_files.role: present iff the denominator is degraded/unavailable; documents the failure rather than silently passing

reproducibility_scope.rationale: wall-clock timing is inherently non-deterministic; the byte-identical assertion is scoped to the sorted per-case projection (case_id + source_sha256 + behavior_equivalent + equivalence_group). The corpus content digest is locked separately and is not part of correctness_verdict_hash.

checks: correctness verdicts reproduce their recorded hash (FE-REPRO-0003)
manifest-recorded digests match recomputed sha256 of env/lock/results (FE-REPRO-0004)
repro.lock partner present and binds the correctness-verdict hash (FE-REPRO-0005)
denominator is within the freshness window and meets the sample floor (FE-REPRO-0007)

degraded_policy.trigger: node/bun unavailable, not genuine, fairness rules unmet, or no admitted case
degraded_policy.action: write degraded_receipt.json with error_code FE-REPRO-0007 and verdict=degraded
degraded_policy.promotion_rule: degraded mode must never promote claim status to observed; FE-CLAIM-010 stays target

claim_linkage.honest_finding: the preserved historical ratios are diagnostic because their source state, runtime pins, aggregation, lifecycle, and timing-replay contracts are non-certifying; v3 remains degraded and does not evaluate the >=3x floor, so the claim stays target.
